how: Qiaobo Indoor Ski Resort in Shunyi offers year-round indoor skiing and snowboarding with a kids' snow park and ski school (about RMB 200-380 per 4-hour session); Abit Indoor Ski Club in Chaoyang runs a simulator-based indoor snow club.
venue: Qiaobo Indoor Ski Resort (乔波室内滑雪馆)

how: SURFPARK in Chaoyang runs an indoor surf-pool venue with one-on-one beginner lessons and free trial slides; 17SURF and Wavorhouse (威波豪欺) were also reported as indoor surf clubs.
venue: SURFPARK (温泉冲浪·深水冲浪体验店)

how: The annual Beijing Public Archaeology Season runs hands-on study tours and a Great Wall archaeological repair experience at sites such as Liulihe, Zhoukoudian and Jiankou; there is no regular open excavation programme for adults and registration details are not published.
venue: Beijing Public Archaeology Season (Zhoukoudian Peking Man Site Museum)

how: Trendy-toy and blind-box fairs such as the May 2026 New Culture Market and Trendy Toy Garden Party in Chaoyang Park draw collectors; the Hobby Expo China model show is held annually at the Beijing Exhibition Centre; no permanent collectors' club was confirmed.
The Beijing International Coin Expo (28th edition in 2025, Oct 31-Nov 2, National Convention Center) gathers dealers and collectors annually; no permanent coin club or class was confirmed.
venue: Beijing International Coin Expo (National Convention Center)
